Wynn Resorts Announces Private Offering of $900 Million of Wynn Resorts Finance Senior Notes due 2035
LAS VEGAS, September 10, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Wynn Resorts, Limited (NASDAQ: WYNN) (“Wynn Resorts”) announced today that Wynn Resorts Finance, LLC (“Wynn Resorts Finance”) and its subsidiary Wynn Resorts Capital Corp.
